subject: Portal vs Email: invoice field alignment & onboarding form items
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elenat@acme-supplies.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor onboarding: invoice submission method & payload samples

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the onboarding kickoff yesterday. We have the first batch of invoices ready and want to confirm the preferred intake method and exact CSV/PDF expectations so our AP team can automate. Two quick questions: do you prefer invoices submitted through the Redwood vendor portal (recommended by our ops team) or via email to billing@redwood.com as a fallback? And can you share the canonical CSV headers you accept (we currently export PO-level CSVs with line items in separate rows)?

I've attached: acme_invoice_sample.csv (export from our ERP) and a filled onboarding form so you can see our vendor identifier and tax setup.

Notes from our side: we often attach a PDF per PO, and some clients require tax breakdowns on each line. Happy to adapt — just want to avoid back-and-forth.

Appreciate the guidance — Elena
Elena Torres
Billing Lead, Acme Supplies
+65 9123 4567

Attachments: acme_invoice_sample.csv (CSV), vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (PDF)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elenat@acme-supplies.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: invoice submission method & payload samples

Hi Elena — thanks for sending the sample and the form. Welcome aboard!

Short answer: portal preferred; email allowed as a documented fallback. Reasoning: portal gives us stable PO linkage, automatic ack/ID tokens, and better traceability for SLA/crediting. Email is fine if you need a transitional route, but we will need a strict subject token and a CSV mapping to ensure automatic ingestion.

Key requirements (portal):
- Upload a single invoice artifact per PO in the portal UI (PDF or PDF+CSV).
- Portal will surface a unique Redwood invoice ID and immediate status (accepted/rejected).

Fallback: email to billing@redwood.com
- Subject line MUST include: VendorID=<your_vendor_id> PO=<po_number> (example: VendorID=ACME-72 PO=98765)
- Attachments: a PDF of the invoice and an optional CSV. If supplying CSV, match our canonical headers.

Mapping guidance (attached redwood_invoice_template.csv):
- invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), po_number, line_number, item_description, quantity, unit_price, line_total, tax_amount, currency, vendor_id
- For multi-PO invoices: include separate rows with the corresponding po_number; avoid embedding multiple PO numbers in one row.
- Tax: accept either line-level tax_amount or a separate summary_tax_amount field; we prefer line-level so reconciliation is simpler.

Action items:
1) Please confirm whether you can adopt the portal within two weeks.
2) If email fallback is required, confirm you will use the subject token format and that you can match the attached CSV headers.

I've attached redwood_invoice_template.csv and a short onboarding checklist (onboarding_form_v2.pdf) for reference. Kimberly — can you confirm any exceptions for APAC VAT handling? Jordan — FYI on PO linking and downstream ledger mapping.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_invoice_template.csv (CSV), onboarding_form_v2.pdf (PDF)

From: Elena Torres <elenat@acme-supplies.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@acme-supplies.com
Date: 2027-08-05T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: invoice submission method & payload samples

On Thu, Aug 4, 2027 at 11:05 AM, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Short answer: portal preferred; email allowed as a documented fallback.
> ...

Thanks Vanessa — super helpful. A couple of clarifying items from our AP team before we move resources: 

1) Multi-PO bundling: our ERP can either export one CSV per PO or one CSV that contains multiple PO numbers (one row per line, different po_number values). From your mapping notes I understand either is fine as long as each row has the correct po_number. Confirm?

2) Tax presentation: you prefer line-level tax_amount. For some countries we currently send a single tax summary row per invoice (summary_tax_amount). Will that be rejected or cause manual reconciliation?

3) Subject token: our vendor id in your example would be ACME-SG-72. Are hyphens acceptable?

4) Is there a maximum attachments size if we fall back to email? We often zip multiple PDFs for a single submission.

Appreciate the quick answers — Elena

Elena Torres
Billing Lead, Acme Supplies
Attachments included previously: acme_invoice_sample.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elenat@acme-supplies.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-06T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: invoice submission method & payload samples

Hi Elena — looping in AP ops to give definitive guidance and avoid any manual exceptions. Apologies for the short note, want to be explicit so your automation team can proceed.

Answers: 
1) Multi-PO: Confirmed — one CSV with multiple rows for different po_number values is fully supported. We will treat each row independently and attempt to match each row to an existing PO. If a row cannot be matched, that row will be flagged and the invoice will be partially accepted (portal) or routed to manual review (email fallback).

2) Tax: We accept both line-level tax_amount and a summary_tax_amount. For automatic reconciliation prefer line-level. If you send only summary_tax_amount, add summary_tax_currency and summary_tax_basis so ops can auto-apply.

3) Vendor ID: Hyphens are fine. The subject token parser accepts alphanumerics, dashes and underscores. Example subject we support: "VendorID=ACME-SG-72 PO=98765". Please make sure there are no additional punctuation characters.

4) Email attachments: Max total attachment size for billing@redwood.com is 40MB. Zipping multiple PDFs is OK as long as the subject token is present and the CSV (if present) matches the template. For large batches please use portal upload or SFTP (we can provide credentials).

Next steps:
- If you can pilot portal in 10 business days we will schedule a short onboarding session (15 min) with our portal team.
- If portal is not feasible, confirm you'll use the subject token and attach the CSV matching redwood_invoice_template.csv. Once we receive a test invoice we'll validate and return an ack token.

I've attached a single-page onboarding_instructions_sheet.pdf with the subject examples and a checklist for your AP team.

Thanks — Marissa Cole
Sr. AP Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: onboarding_instructions_sheet.pdf
